title: First Unique

story.briefing: Every padding character in this packet repeats. The one that does not is the marker, and its position is the offset the decoder needs.
story.success: Marker located. The decoder locks on.

description: Given a string, return the index of the first character that appears exactly once in the whole string. If every character repeats, or the string is empty, return -1.

examples.explanation: c is the first character occurring once.

hints: You cannot know whether the first character is unique until you have looked at the whole string. That suggests more than one pass.
Count first, decide second. Trying to answer during a single pass leads to re-scanning the tail for every character.
Pass one: count every character. Pass two: walk the string from the start and return the index of the first character whose count is 1. Return -1 if none qualifies.
